name: Kyojin-tachi ZERO Div1
source:
"Concentrate on reason and enlightenment. If you can not control your right hand, the world will come to an end."

This work "Div1" is composed of new characters who have not appeared in the previous works. 

We are taking a step towards the conclusion of ZERO however,

The aspect of the world is layed down on the fatal situation in the face of geographical, temporal, spatial, and transcendental unevenness.

Approaching on the Consciousness and Unconsciousness, Neurons, the arbitrariness of language, and the disconnect that exists in an incomprehensible world. 

We attempt an experiment in which we cut out and project the psychological world of the imaginer or the created person.
translation:
“专注于理性和启蒙。如果你不能控制你的右手，世界将会终结。”

本作《Div1》由前作中未曾出现过的新角色组成。

然而，我们正在朝着“零”的目标迈出一步，

世界的面貌是在地理、时间、空间和先验不平衡面前的致命处境。

探讨意识与无意识、神经元、语言的任意性以及存在于不可理解的世界中的脱节。

我们尝试进行一项实验，在其中我们剪切并投射想象者或被创造者的心理世界。
